text:
```yaml
name: PR Title Check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  check-pr-title:
    name: Validate PR Title Format
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check PR Title
        uses: amannn/action-semantic-pull-request@v5
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          # Regex to enforce: (TYPE) description [TASK-ID]
          # TYPE: chore, fix, feat, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, revert
          # TASK-ID: DA- followed by digits
          subject-pattern: ^\((chore|fix|feat|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|revert)\) .+ \[DA-\d+\]$
          subject-pattern-error: |
            The PR title must follow the format: `(TYPE) description [TASK-ID]`
            - TYPE must be one of: chore, fix, feat, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, revert
            - TASK-ID must be in the format DA-123
            Example: `(chore) update dependencies [DA-179]`
```
